frame: game (x=dE, y=Z-56.16, z=-dN; Y up, m; origin Kroepcke clock)
notes: Each tile: <name>.glb (shell + facade details, node *_shell_nocol / *_detail_nocol) and <name>_win.glb (instanced window/door/shopfront assemblies, EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing with _COLOR_0 instance colours).
Load *_win.glb only for tiles within ~150-200 m of the camera; the shell already closes every opening (reveal + dark back plane), so far tiles look right without it.
No normals are stored: three.js uses flatShading automatically.
Materials are shared by name (bldg_*); dedupe them across tiles after loading to share textures (textures/*.jpg are referenced externally).
Collision: collision_buildings.glb (LoD2 solids; canopies as slab + posts).
Quality gates (check_rays.py): every exposed facade is hit by rays from 3 m at every storey/axis; every window glass instance sits in a shell opening with a back plane; shell bounding spheres valid.
